messages:
alex: security-bot just flagged plaintext creds inside a Terraform state backup in GCS (bucket infra-tfstate-backups). Pattern looks like PG_CONN=postgres://user:PASS123. Need containment + rotation.

security-bot: (automated) leak_detected severity=high path=gs://infra-tfstate-backups/2025-08-01/terraform.tfstate pattern=PASS123

maria: I'll own triage. First: is the state file still live as active state for prod infra or only archived? infra, can you confirm?

infra: Confirmed: it's an old backup copy (retention copies). Prod uses remote state in backend v2 (GCS) but we keep periodic snapshots in that bucket. The leaked secret appears in snapshot dated 2025-08-01.

alex: Treat as compromised. Steps: 1) rotate DB credential 2) update Vault secret (kv v2) and rewrap with KMS 3) patch terraform state to remove plaintext and re-encrypt snapshot, 4) tighten RBAC on bucket and Vault paths.

maria: I'll rotate DB creds with db-team and generate new credential, then write to Vault. We'll use Cloud KMS rewrap and capture key version for audit.

infra: Before rotation completes, I'll revoke public read on tfstate backups and apply a temporary IAM policy that restricts bucket access to infra-admins and security for 24h. Command:
```bash
gsutil iam ch group:infra-admins:objectViewer gs://infra-tfstate-backups
# revoke allUsers
gsutil iam ch -d allUsers:objectViewer gs://infra-tfstate-backups
```

maria: Writing new credential into Vault now and rewrapping with KMS. Vault request_id=req-tf-2026. KMS key version: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/tf-keys/cryptoKeyVersions/5

alex: For state hygiene we need to rewrite the snapshot to remove the plaintext (replace with redacted) and re-upload. infra, schedule an archive rewrite job and mark the incident ticket. Also run git history scan to ensure TF vars weren't committed.

infra: Starting archive-rewrite job JOB-TF-101 to scrub snapshots for 2019-2025. Also adding pre-upload check in snapshot job to strip secrets and fail on token regex.

security-bot: post-rotation scan: initial_matches=1 post_rotation_matches=0 scanned_path=gs://infra-tfstate-backups/2025-

legal: Please capture timeline and export Vault/KMS audit entries. We'll need these for compliance. legal needs detection time, rotation time, KMS key id, Vault request_id, and list of affected snapshots.

maria: Detection 2026-03-21T21:03:54Z, rotation complete 2026-03-21T21:28:10Z. Vault req=req-tf-2026. KMS key version projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/tf-keys/cryptoKeyVersions/5. Affected snapshots: 2025-08-01.

alex: RBAC follow-up: create a short-lived Vault policy denying read to non-owners for secret/data/db/prod for 12h and then run a permissions audit. Assign to infra/sre to verify.

infra: Will apply policy and run permission audit. Also will rotate any CI tokens or images that referenced that state during builds.

maria: Postmortem items: enforce scrubbing in snapshot pipeline, shorten snapshot retention, migrate DB creds to ephemeral rotation (short TTL), and add automated alerts for token-like patterns in backups. Scheduling 30-min postmortem tomorrow.

alex: Thanks team. Marking INCIDENT-2026-03-21-TFSTATE in containment. We'll update ticket with audit artifacts.
